headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.physicalNeighbors_map_computedStateCode
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (x : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
      List.map (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L)
          (Math115.RationalClockProposal.physicalNeighbors r c U L x) =
        OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.codeNeighbors
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.codeCheckData
            (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedCatalog r c U) (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
            (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L x))

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawClockNeighborDraw_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ),
  ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
    ∀ (x : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (N : ℕ)
      (word :
        Fin (N * Math115.RationalClockProposal.precision (Math115.RationalClockProposal.denominator r c U)) → Bool),
      Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.rawClockNeighborDraw
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.codeCheckData
            (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedCatalog r c U) (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
            (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑x))
          (Math115.RationalClockProposal.denominator r c U) N word =
        Option.map (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L)
          (Math115.RationalClockProposal.physicalProposal r c U L x N word)
